name: BBlockerBuf
description: Audio-rate Betablocker virtual machine voice. Reads a 256-byte program out of the supplied buffer and runs Dave Griffiths' Betablocker stack-machine bytecode at audio rate, emitting up to 9 simultaneous output channels (one per VM voice slot). Inspired by the Betablocker handheld livecoding instrument. From sc3-plugins BetablockerUGens.

inputs.name: freq
inputs.description: Clock frequency for the VM in Hertz — controls how fast bytecodes are executed

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer holding the 256-byte program (load via BBlockerProgram.makeBuffer or asLocalBuf)

name: DetaBlockerBuf
description: Demand-rate Betablocker bytecode stream. Runs Dave Griffiths' Betablocker stack-machine over a 256-byte program loaded from a buffer, emitting one VM output value per demand pull — typically wrapped in Demand.ar for clocked playback. From sc3-plugins BetablockerUGens.

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer holding the 256-byte program (load via BBlockerProgram.makeBuffer or asLocalBuf)
